program.name: Fighter 25
program.subject: Fighter
program.blurb: Twenty-five minutes: shadowboxing bouts, then a core circuit a fighter would recognise.
program.about: A fighter's session in twenty-five minutes. Three bouts of shadowboxing come first, one combination per bout called by the voice. Then a core circuit of planks, twists and hollow holds, the trunk strength that keeps a fighter balanced and protected. Levels II and III bring longer combinations and add reps to the core.
